summary: This plan keeps track of the fixtures of your community football league in Kumasi. You can add teams by name, schedule a fixture on a date between a home team and an away team, record the score after the match, and see all the fixtures of one team, whether it plays at home or away. Following your answers: we will not check whether a team has two fixtures on the same date, recording a score again simply replaces the old score, and team names do not have to be unique. Nothing in your request was unsafe or outside the backend, so nothing was left out. A question for you: should anyone be able to see and change this information, or would you like to limit who can record scores? This plan does not include any such limit unless you ask for it.

data.name: Fixture
fields: goals scored by the home team (empty until the score is recorded)
goals scored by the away team (empty until the score is recorded)

endpoints.does: Adds a new team with its name.
Shows the list of all teams.
Schedules a new fixture on a date between a home team and an away team.
Records the score of a fixture: how many goals the home team and the away team scored. Recording it again replaces the old score.
Shows all the fixtures of one team, both the ones it plays at home and the ones it plays away.

rules: A team must have a name.
A fixture must have a date, a home team and an away team.
The home team and the away team must be teams that have already been added.
A team cannot play against itself: the home team and the away team must be different.
A score can only be recorded for a fixture that exists.
A score must give the goals for both the home team and the away team, as whole numbers.
